mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies and a beautiful Full Moon near Verona Area High School, but please note the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 77. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials are currently reviewing several land use proposals for the Plan Commission meeting on November 4, including the Ardent Glen development and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will be hitting mailboxes by December 15.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga on October 26 and trivia throughout the early part of next week.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of erratic driving. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a potential sign collision related to the incident.
You can look forward to a treat of Turtle today at Culver's, which opens today at 10:00 AM.
